At Chimcare, we're committed to delivering exceptional chimney services throughout Washington state.

Our expert team has been ensuring the safety and efficiency of chimneys from Seattle to Spokane, Tacoma to Vancouver. We understand the unique challenges posed by Washington's diverse climate, from the rainy western regions to the drier eastern areas, and tailor our services accordingly.

Trust Chimcare — keeping Washington's chimneys safe, efficient, and well-maintained since 1989.

  • Western WashingtonPersistent rain, moss and algae, moisture in the masonry
  • Eastern WashingtonDrier air, colder winters, harder freeze-thaw cycles
  • StatewideSeismic considerations and Washington fire safety codes

Sweeping

Washington chimney sweep services: keeping your home safe and warm.

Regular chimney sweeping is crucial in Washington's damp climate, where creosote buildup can occur more rapidly. Our Washington chimney sweep services go beyond simple cleaning:

  • Thorough removal of creosote, soot, and debris
  • Inspection for moisture damage, common in our climate
  • Checking for and removing any wildlife nests, a frequent issue in Washington chimneys
  • Ensuring proper drafting to prevent smoke backflow

By choosing Chimcare for your Washington chimney sweep needs, you're not just getting a clean chimney — you're investing in your home's safety and efficiency.

Repair

Expert Washington chimney repair: restoring function and safety.

Washington's weather can take a toll on chimneys. Our comprehensive Washington chimney repair services address issues specific to our region:

  • Repairing water damage from our frequent rains
  • Fixing cracks caused by freeze-thaw cycles
  • Rebuilding chimney crowns and caps to withstand harsh weather
  • Installing or replacing flue liners to combat moisture issues
  • Tuckpointing and masonry repair using materials suited for Washington's climate
Request a repair quote

More detail

Inspections, Washington-specific services and what sets us apart.

The full detail is here — open only the parts that apply to your home.

Our detailed Washington chimney inspection services are tailored to address local concerns:

  • Checking for moss or algae growth, common in our moist environment
  • Assessing the integrity of chimney flashing to prevent leaks
  • Evaluating the chimney's structure for earthquake resilience
  • Ensuring compliance with Washington state fire safety codes

Our additional services cater to Washington's unique needs:

  • Installation of rain caps and cricket systems to combat heavy rainfall
  • Waterproofing services for chimneys in high-moisture areas
  • Seismic retrofitting for older chimneys in earthquake-prone regions
  • Custom masonry work to match Washington's diverse architectural styles
  • Local expertise: we understand Washington's climate and building styles.
  • Comprehensive services: from Seattle's houseboats to Eastern Washington's farmhouses, we do it all.
  • Certified professionals: our team is trained in Washington's specific chimney challenges.
  • Eco-friendly practices: we use environmentally safe products, aligning with Washington's green values.
  • Emergency services: available for urgent chimney issues, especially during our storm seasons.

Three services are priced up front: a chimney sweep with inspection is $299, a chimney inspection on its own is $69, and a gas fireplace diagnostic is $49.

Repair and masonry work is quoted on site after an inspection, and the estimate is free. You'll see the price before any work starts.
